requirementMap: Real-time collaboration: validates inverse operations before shared document mutation.
Version history and autosave: ties undo/redo to section versions and restore snapshots.
Rich scientific editing: protects notebook outputs, final-review sections, comments, and task anchors.
Audit logs: emits reviewer-ready allow, defer, or block decisions for every request.

actions: Apply inverse operation and append an audit event with target operation, actor, and snapshot hash.

issues.message: Author attempted to undo another collaborator's operation.
Newer edits overlap the target range.

actions: Require explicit editor override before applying the inverse operation.
Open a conflict review instead of applying the undo automatically.

issues.message: Undo/redo request is based on an older section version.
Newer edits overlap the target range.

actions: Rebase the inverse operation against the latest section version.
Open a conflict review instead of applying the undo automatically.

issues.message: Undo/redo would mutate a locked final-review section.
Notebook execution undo/redo lacks an output restore snapshot.

actions: Require lock-owner approval before inverse operation application.
Attach notebook output and execution-count snapshot before mutation.
Apply inverse operation and append an audit event with target operation, actor, and snapshot hash.

issues.message: Author attempted to undo another collaborator's operation.
Undo request would remove another reviewer's anchored comment.

actions: Require explicit editor override before applying the inverse operation.
Keep the reviewer comment and create a separate resolution task.
